services.desc: Nine & Dines run monthly-nine holes in the evening, dinner on the terrace afterward. It's the format that fits a weeknight without taking over the day. Couples who play together have made it a standing ritual. Some members come for the dinner and skip the golf-the camaraderie is just that

blurb: Bent Pine Golf Club offers a challenging 18-hole golf course designed by Joe Lee, unchanged since 1979. The club hosts social events including Mah Jongg, wine dinners, live music, and dancing. Membership includes a welcoming community with golf and non-golf activities.
